contract: construct() -> {'n': n, 'colors': [...]}: one colour in {0,...,4} for each pair (i,j), i<j, of vertices 0..n-1 in lexicographic order, 1 <= n <= 29. No colour class may contain a four-cycle (no two vertices with two common neighbours in one colour). Maximize n.
notes: A valid 5-colouring of K_n certifies R_5(C4) > n. The algebraic construction of Lazebnik and Woldar gives 26 vertices; 27 or 28 would be new. Exact local certificates are not Lean proofs. Consult the independent oracle and malformed-input tests.
